reference_limit: The five approved concepts contain no dedicated event, dialog or help screen. Comparison uses the common hierarchy, header, body and action typography; it does not invent a matching event concept.
findings: Real Condensed Bold headings and SemiBold action labels remain distinct from Roboto Regular explanations and real Roboto Bold screen titles/values.
20 real events and 60 options retain readable effects, accents, currency and duration. Native wrapping and the existing scroll masks preserve access to all content.

Dialog long body, error message, scrim and focus ring remain readable; their original action sizes and layout are retained.
The partially clipped first history row in the bottom capture is the expected viewport scroll position, rather than text truncation. The top capture records its full beginning.
